title: hubQuotaPills
responsibility: Words each subscription's header quota pill: level, room left or Lisbon reset time, and what each limit is.

inputs.name: quotaPills.subscriptions
inputs.description: The owner's subscription readings, in any provider order.

inputs.name: quotaPills.now
inputs.description: Current time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch, for stale readings and reset wording.

outputs.name: quotaPills
outputs.description: Pills with Claude first: id, provider, level, warning word, visible text and the plain explanation of each limit.
